'''Mud crabs''' were [[Crustacean/Legends|crustaceans]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]]. [[Kristoff Stonelaw|Kristoff]] and [[Yuri Stonelaw]] caught mud crabs and build pens out of dirt to hold them, but the creatures managed to escape.<ref name="TD">{{JournalCite|15|The Draw}}</ref>
